newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Manga-Chem faces listing suspension - JSE.
newsitem.headline: Manga-Chem faces listing suspension - JSE.

text.p: Manga-Chemical Products Ltd was under threat of its securities listing being suspended and possibly terminated because of the late submission of its financial statements, the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.

The JSE said that the company had failed to submit its financial statements within six months of its financial year end and should it not submit its annual statements by end-September its listing would automatically be suspended.
Shareholders were cautioned that the company had been informed of the threat.
